name: Beyond Paradise
description: After leaving paradise and seeking a quieter life, Humphrey has taken a job as Detective Inspector in his fiancée Martha's hometown. But with the high crime rate, maybe things will be louder than expected.

videos.title: Christmas Special 2023
videos.overview: An eccentric burglar breaks into four homes over a winter's night but steals nothing. In fact, he leaves things behind for the bemused residents to find in the morning.

videos.title: Christmas Special 2024
videos.overview: When a widower starts seeing the ghost of his late wife, DS Esther Williams is deeply sceptical, but DI Humphrey Goodman is more than happy to dive into his first haunting.

videos.title: Comic Relief Special 2025: Not Going Beyond Paradise
videos.overview: Sally Bretton has her roles from Beyond Paradise and Not Going Out collide in a comedy sketch for 2025 Comic Relief's Red Nose Day.

videos.title: Christmas Special 2025
videos.overview: With unexpected visitors, festive cases to solve and a heartwarming reunion on the line, can the team juggle it all and still be ready in time for Martha’s Christmas surprise?

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: A new adventure awaits as DI Humphrey Goodman and Martha leave London for Devon. Humphrey dives into his first case, which involves an unusual prime suspect: a 17th-century witch.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Humphrey and his team are baffled by the mysterious disappearance of an entire family. Martha prepares for the launch of her café but is thrown when a face from the past shows up.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: The community of Shipton Abbott is rocked when a beloved painting disappears in a seemingly impossible heist. Humphrey tries his best to find some common ground with Archie.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Humphrey investigates the death of an unidentified man found in the centre of a crop circle. Meanwhile, Archie helps Martha prepare for a visit from a food critic.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Panic spreads when an arsonist targets three businesses, bizarrely invoking the Three Little Pigs fable. Meanwhile, Martha has some serious thinking to do.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: A house is burgled but the prime suspect was locked up in a police cell at the time. It’s up to Esther to rally a devastated Humphrey and solve this impossible crime.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: The Shipton Abbott Players rope in Humphrey to play a detective, but the fictional crime becomes real when the amateur murder victim gets a real knife in his back.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: When an amateur psychic’s unsettling predictions for a grieving woman’s future start to come true, Humphrey must uncover the truth before it’s too late.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: When a dying woman goes missing from a local fishing trawler, Humphrey suspects there’s more to her disappearance than meets the eye.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: When a priest at a Catholic boarding school goes missing, Humphrey’s team explores a connection between his disappearance and an ancient local legend.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: On a moor outside of Shipton Abbott, a woman is found with an arrow in her back and no sign of who might have shot her.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: It's finally Humphrey and Martha's wedding day – what could possibly go wrong? Other than a museum heist, cyber crime and an unexpected arrival.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: When a body is found in the river on the county border, Humphrey and Esther are brought face to face with their Cornish counterparts.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: An old friend of Kelby starts to receive malicious messages from an unknown source. Before danger strikes, can the team uncover who's hiding behind the screen?

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: A local chocolatier falls under suspicion after three customers are poisoned by her confections. The team must work quickly to uncover the culprit before public panic spreads.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: An old sailing rivalry resurfaces at the regatta when a sailor collapses mid-race. A tampered smoothie is identified as the cause, casting suspicion on Martha.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: The myth of the Cornman turns real when a masked figure strikes a local farm. With the farm’s future at risk, can Humphrey unmask the saboteur before their livelihood is wiped out?

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: When nurse Lucy vanishes on her way to work, suspicion falls on Josh Woods – Kelby’s rival. But could the legend of the Devil’s Hump hold a vital clue to solving her disappearance?

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: When the circumstances of a crime novelist’s death eerily mirror the details of his final novel, Humphrey must uncover whether it was a coincidence or murder by design.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: A couple are targeted by a burglar who repeatedly sneaks back in to clean up without a trace. With several potential suspects, Humphrey must uncover who is out for revenge.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: When a member of her Morris team is targeted mid-performance, Margo is just as shocked as the audience. But with all eyes on the dancers, how was he attacked in plain sight?

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: When a seaweed farm is targeted in an act of sabotage, all evidence points to the legendary mermaid of Shipton Abbott.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: An off-grid community is thrust into the spotlight when a land developer is terrorised by the image of a Green Man. As tensions rise, secrets surface that someone wants buried.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: A priceless artefact is stolen from the pirate festival, only to suddenly reappear on the police station steps. But who stands to gain from its brief disappearance?
